column10: text=Hey Kenneth, it's Eireanne! I was wondering if you could help me, I was looking at an Apple MacBook Air 13.3" on the currys website, the product code is 128874! I was wondering if you would be able to have a look and see if it was with me getting and if there's any packages I should definitely buy with it! Would really appreciate it!
text=Hi Eireanne, I would get one that has 8GB of ram. I would  wait until this Friday (Black Friday). I got mine this time last year. Hopefully there will be some good deals.
text=Okay thank you! Yea I was thinking of waiting til then to get it hopefully get a wee deal
text=Do you need Microsoft office for a MacBook? Just cause I might need it for uni
text=Yes, but I can get you a copy of it.
text=It does have it’s own ‘office’ software, but you can also install Open Office, which I have a copy of.
text=Did you try to send me a message?
text=Hi Eireanne, I've left a USB stick up at my Mum's with Open Office on it.
